name: Ukrainian TTS Fixed-Stress Lexicon
description: Community-maintained lexicon of Ukrainian wordforms with authoritative fixed lexical stress, intended for ingestion by Text-to-Speech / automated dubbing pipelines.
normative_references: Орфоепічний словник української мови (Інститут української мови НАН України)

uppercase.description: The stressed vowel is written as a single uppercase letter; all other letters are lowercase. Serialization format only: engines MUST match against the lowercase 'form'.

combining.description: U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT placed immediately after the stressed vowel. Strings are kept in NFC; Cyrillic vowels have no precomposed acute forms, so the mark stays a separate code point.

notation.stress_char_index: 0-based index (in Unicode code points) of the stressed vowel inside 'form'.
notation.stress_syllable: 1-based ordinal of the stressed syllable, counted from the start of the word.
notation.grammemes: Universal Dependencies (UD v2) feature names and values, lowercased keys (case, number, gender, person, tense, verb_form, aspect, num_type, pron_type). number 'Ptan' marks plurale tantum.
notation.sense: Optional short English gloss that separates lexical homographs with identical grammemes (e.g. замок 'castle' vs 'lock').
notation.disambiguate_by: How a homograph is resolved: 'grammemes' (case/number), 'pos' (part of speech), 'aspect' (verb aspect) or 'sense' (word meaning).

status_values.seed: Initial entry checked against the normative references; awaiting independent review by a second contributor.
status_values.verified: Confirmed by at least two independent reviewers with a cited normative source.
status_values.deprecated: Kept for traceability; MUST NOT be applied.

matching.homograph_policy: Entries with 'homograph': true share the same surface 'form' with a different stress. Apply them only after morphological disambiguation (grammemes); 'context_hints' are a fallback heuristic, not a rule.
